sandbox.description: Kernel sandbox for commands. "static": seccomp deny filter (io_uring, ptrace, mount/namespace, bpf, kexec, keyctl). "fence": static + a Landlock ruleset -- workspace roots and /tmp-style scratch read-write, system dirs plus the $PATH dirs read-only, everything else (including home dirs: `cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa` fails) unreachable, and every network action the kernel's Landlock ABI knows denied (TCP bind+connect from ABI v4, UDP bind/send from ABI v10; `hotdog info` prints which). Allowlist-only, so workspace.deny is NOT enforced by either sandboxed mode -- `cat .env` succeeds under `fence`; only the file tools bind the deny list. All policy is installed before exec: there is no per-operation mediation and no approval prompt mid-command. Linux x86_64 only; fails at startup when unavailable. Does not restrict network for "static". Comparison table: docs/config-reference.md.
